reports.title: Resideo Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Updates 2026 Outlook

guidance.heading: Outlook
section: The following table summarizes Resideo’s fourth quarter 2026 and updated full year 2026 outlook:

($ in millions, except per share data) | Q4 2026 | 2026
Revenue | $710 - $730 | $2,927 - $2,947
Standalone Adjusted EBITDA (1) | $145 - $155 | $614 - $624
Standalone Adjusted Earnings Per Share (1) | $0.42 - $0.48 | $1.92 - $1.98
Full Year Cash Provided by Operating Activities | At least $165
